<action_input>{"code": "import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode

# Set operating mode to tapping mode (PhaseContrast) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 s per line (total 51.2 s for 128 lines)

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Points: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"  Operating mode: PhaseContrast (tapping mode)")

# Start scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Try to get the file path
try:
    # Check if there's a Gallery object
    gallery = application.Gallery
    last_file = gallery.GetLastSavedFilePath()
    print(f"\nLast saved file path: {last_file}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"\nError getting file path via Gallery: {e}")
    # Try alternative method
    try:
        last_file = application.GetLastSavedFilePath()
        print(f"Last saved file path (alternative): {last_file}")
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"Error with alternative method: {e2}")

del spm"}</action_input>
